units.id: news:coalition games planet heliarch|"A former athlete myself, I am. Earned my rank by winning in the Games, I did, so always eager to help organize the event, I am."|401|0
units.english: "A former athlete myself, I am. Earned my rank by winning in the Games, I did, so always eager to help organize the event, I am."
units.italian: "Ex atleta io stesso, sono. Guadagnato il mio rango vincendo ai Giochi, ho, quindi sempre desideroso di aiutare a organizzare l'evento, sono."

units.id: news:coalition games planet people|"Brought my children to see the Games, I have. An important part of our culture, the Games are, so glad to share the experience with them, I am."|420|0
units.english: "Brought my children to see the Games, I have. An important part of our culture, the Games are, so glad to share the experience with them, I am."
units.italian: "Portato i miei figli a vedere i Giochi, ho. Una parte importante della nostra cultura, i Giochi sono, quindi felice di condividere l'esperienza con loro, sono."

units.id: news:coalition games planet people|"Brought my children to see the Games, I have. Hope I do, that behave themselves this time, they will..."|421|0
units.english: "Brought my children to see the Games, I have. Hope I do, that behave themselves this time, they will..."
units.italian: "Portato i miei figli a vedere i Giochi, ho. Lo spero, che questa volta si comportino bene, che lo facciano..."

units.id: news:coalition games planet people|"Here for the Games too, are you? The largest event in all the Coalition, it is. Come here to watch every year, I do!"|422|0
units.english: "Here for the Games too, are you? The largest event in all the Coalition, it is. Come here to watch every year, I do!"
units.italian: "Qui per i Giochi anche tu, sei? Il più grande evento di tutta la Coalizione, è. Venire qui a guardare ogni anno, io lo faccio!"

units.id: news:coalition games planet people|"Come to watch a relative of mine compete, I have. Training hard for many years, they have been, so sure I am that do well, they will."|423|0
units.english: "Come to watch a relative of mine compete, I have. Training hard for many years, they have been, so sure I am that do well, they will."
units.italian: "Venuto a guardare gareggiare un mio familiare, sono. Allenatosi duramente per molti anni, si è, quindi sicuro che farà bene, sono."

units.id: news:fangvin beyond the hyperdrive news|So great, this 'Beyond the Hyperdrive' book is! Read it, I have!|460|0
units.english: So great, this 'Beyond the Hyperdrive' book is! Read it, I have!
units.italian: Così bello, questo libro 'Beyond the Hyperdrive' è! Letto, l'ho!

units.id: news:fangvin beyond the hyperdrive news|Read from a human, I never have, but when Anna Fangvin, I found, buy her book I did!|461|0
units.english: Read from a human, I never have, but when Anna Fangvin, I found, buy her book I did!
units.italian: Leggere da un umano, non l'ho mai fatto, ma quando ho trovato Anna Fangvin, comprare il suo libro, l'ho fatto!

units.id: news:fangvin beyond the hyperdrive news|Very nice, Anna Fangvin was, for sign my book, she did with much joy!|462|0
units.english: Very nice, Anna Fangvin was, for sign my book, she did with much joy!
units.italian: Molto gentile, Anna Fangvin è stata, per firmare il mio libro, l'ha fatto con grande gioia!

units.id: news:fangvin beyond the hyperdrive news|Read all of 'Beyond the Hyperdrive', I did! Inspired by those who stole from our oppressors, I was!|463|0
units.english: Read all of 'Beyond the Hyperdrive', I did! Inspired by those who stole from our oppressors, I was!
units.italian: Letto tutto 'Beyond the Hyperdrive', ho! Ispirato da quelli che hanno rubato ai nostri oppressori, sono stato!

units.id: news:lunarium charity worker|"Help bring amenity goods and services to those who can't afford them, we do. Operate mostly in Kimek space we do, if interested in helping you are."|492|0
units.english: "Help bring amenity goods and services to those who can't afford them, we do. Operate mostly in Kimek space we do, if interested in helping you are."
units.italian: "Aiutare a portare beni e servizi essenziali a chi non può permetterseli, facciamo. Operiamo soprattutto nello spazio Kimek, se interessato ad aiutare sei."

units.id: news:lunarium charity worker|"Interested in contributing to the charity, are you? Take every sort of donation, we do. Credits, winter supplies, trinkets, old tech devices. Whatever it is, if willing to donate you are, drop them here you can."|493|0
units.english: "Interested in contributing to the charity, are you? Take every sort of donation, we do. Credits, winter supplies, trinkets, old tech devices. Whatever it is, if willing to donate you are, drop them here you can."
units.italian: "Interessato a contribuire alla beneficenza, sei? Accettiamo ogni tipo di donazione, facciamo. Crediti, provviste per l'inverno, ninnoli, vecchi dispositivi tecnologici. Qualunque cosa sia, se disposto a donare sei, lasciarla qui puoi."

units.id: news:lunarium charity worker|"Just finished filling up an entire Arach fleet's cargo holds with school supplies, we have. Very tiring, the job is, but glad I am that making a difference, our charity efforts are."|494|0
units.english: "Just finished filling up an entire Arach fleet's cargo holds with school supplies, we have. Very tiring, the job is, but glad I am that making a difference, our charity efforts are."
units.italian: "Appena finito di riempire le stive di un'intera flotta Arach con materiale scolastico, abbiamo. Molto stancante, il lavoro è, ma contento sono: la differenza, i nostri sforzi di beneficenza la fanno."

units.id: news:lunarium charity worker|"Get most of our funding from some of the Arach Houses and rich Saryd families, we do. Meant only to acquire part of the charity goods and the means to transport them, the credits are, for voluntary work, this is."|495|0
units.english: "Get most of our funding from some of the Arach Houses and rich Saryd families, we do. Meant only to acquire part of the charity goods and the means to transport them, the credits are, for voluntary work, this is."
units.italian: "Prendiamo la maggior parte dei nostri fondi da alcune Case Arach e da ricche famiglie Saryd, facciamo. Servono solo ad acquistare parte dei beni di beneficenza e i mezzi per trasportarli, i crediti sono, per un lavoro volontario, questo è."

units.id: news:lunarium charity worker|Standing by the spaceport entrance, a worker is distributing flyers to those who come in and out. "Hello human visitor. Part of a charity group, I am, raising awareness to our cause. Aware were you, that lack the electronics for many educational activities, children on poor Kimek worlds do? Together, make a difference we can!"|496|0
units.english: Standing by the spaceport entrance, a worker is distributing flyers to those who come in and out. "Hello human visitor. Part of a charity group, I am, raising awareness to our cause. Aware were you, that lack the electronics for many educational activities, children on poor Kimek worlds do? Together, make a difference we can!"
units.italian: All'ingresso dello spazioporto, un addetto distribuisce volantini a chi entra ed esce. "Salve, visitatore umano. Parte di un gruppo di beneficenza, sono, e sensibilizzo sulla nostra causa. Ne eri consapevole, che mancano dell'elettronica per molte attività didattiche, i bambini dei poveri mondi Kimek? Insieme, fare la differenza possiamo!"
